description: This file defines the 'PatientProgramAttribute' class, which extends 'BaseAttribute' and implements 'Attribute'. It models additional attributes associated with a patient's program within the OpenMRS healthcare system, including getter and setter methods and linkages to related entities.

classes.name: PatientProgramAttribute
classes.description: Represents a specific attribute linked to a patient's program, extending functionality from BaseAttribute and supporting attribute management within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this attribute instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this attribute instance.

methods.name: setPatientProgram
methods.description: Associates this attribute with a specific PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeId
methods.description: Gets the internal ID of the patient program attribute.

methods.name: setPatientProgramAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID of the patient program attribute.
